name: Flexible Sigmoidoscopy
description: Document the examined lower bowel, preparation, extent, lesions, sampling and follow-up in an editable flexible sigmoidoscopy report.

name: Obstetric Ultrasound / Morphology
description: Record dating, fetal biometry, assessed anatomy, placenta, fluid and examination limitations. Duplicate fetal sections when appropriate; no automatic dating or growth interpretation.

name: Pelvic / Transvaginal Ultrasound
description: A pelvic ultrasound structure for technique, uterine and endometrial assessment, ovaries, adnexa and fluid, with measurements and limitations.

name: Thyroid and Neck Ultrasound
description: Record gland measurements, individual nodule features and cervical nodes. TI-RADS category is entered by the clinician; this template does not calculate risk or recommend biopsy.
references: American College of Radiology: TI-RADS resources

name: Renal Ultrasound / Renal Artery Doppler
description: Document renal morphology and optional arterial Doppler measurements, sampling sites, waveforms and limitations. Ratios and indices are clinician-entered.

name: Holter / Ambulatory ECG
description: An ambulatory ECG reporting structure for recording quality, rate, rhythm, ectopy, pauses and symptom correlation. Device findings require clinician verification.

name: Ambulatory Blood Pressure Monitoring
description: Record ABPM quality, diary-defined waking and sleeping periods, mean pressures and clinician interpretation. No automatic diagnosis or treatment thresholds.
references: European Society of Hypertension: practice resources

name: General Surgical Operation Note
description: Document the team, indication, operative findings, procedure, specimens, closure and postoperative handover in a reusable operation note.
references: Royal College of Surgeons: operative documentation

name: Caesarean Section Operation Note
description: Capture maternal indication, operative team, delivery details, neonatal handover and operative completion. Duplicate newborn fields for multiple births.
references: Royal College of Surgeons: operative documentation

name: Appendectomy Operation Note
description: Record appendiceal findings, approach, base management, specimen handling, closure and postoperative instructions for an appendectomy.
references: Royal College of Surgeons: operative documentation

name: Wound Debridement / Minor Operation Note
description: Document wound location, dimensions, tissue removed, procedure details, specimens, dressing and follow-up in an adaptable minor-operation note.
references: Royal College of Surgeons: operative documentation

name: Upper GI Endoscopy — Guided
description: A guided OGD / EGD template with optional conditional details. Keep the narrative version for a simpler report.

name: Histopathology Report
description: A general tissue-reporting structure with specimen mapping, macroscopic and microscopic descriptions, and an explicit conclusion. Adapt to specimen-specific protocols.
